notes: The booklet builds two separate models: the red buggy (pages 4-14, pieces b1-b52) and the Cobra Statue (pages 15-47, obelisk plus snake). Nothing in the booklet joins them. The last page only shows them side by side. The graph therefore has two connected groups on purpose, and I have not added a link between them.

Minifigure parts (heads, torsos, legs, hair) are not in the parts list, so they are not recorded. The bag, dynamite, pistol and two snakes are minifigure accessories. They are joined to the buggy seat (b13) or the obelisk base plate (b63), where the minifigure that holds them sits or stands.
The sticker sheet (b201) is one entry. Stickers go on tiles, the 3245c, the 2454a and the bumper per the booklet, but they are not separate parts.
The 2x4 end plates at buggy steps 2-3 and the tan 1x2 plates in step 15 (flipped chassis) are inferred from perspective drawings, so rests_on for the chassis-side pieces is a best guess.
Each cobra body segment (built 4x) needs three Dark Tan 2x4 plates per copy to match the parts list (12 for 4 segments). I assumed the third is stacked on the top plate.
Obelisk: I assumed the slope pairs in steps 10 and 11 stand on the tan 2x4 brick. The corner plates (2420) sit around the bar of the 1x2 bar plate.

The three blue axle pins go in the toggle joint (centre axle hole and two pin holes). One goes into the 1x4 technic brick. The pin at the toggle's arm joins the axle hole of snake segment 2 as shown on page 46, but which snake piece takes it is a best guess.
Snake order head to tail: head, segment 1, joint block 1, segment 2, joint block 2, segment 3, joint block 3, segment 4, tail brick.

The sticker sheet (b201) and hood (b193 etc.) are single entries; stickers go on the 2431 tiles/3245c/4460b/2454a/52038 bumper per the booklet but are not attached as separate parts.

The 2x4 plate/2x4 turned end plates at steps 2-3 of the buggy and the tan 1x2 plates in step 15 (flipped chassis) are inferred from perspective drawings; exact rests_on of the chassis-side pieces is best-effort.
Each cobra body segment (built 4x) needs three Dark Tan 2x4 plates per copy to match the parts list (12 for 4 segments); the third is assumed stacked on the top plate.
Obelisk: the two slope pairs in steps 10 and 11 are assumed to stand on the tan 2x4 brick; corner plates (2420) sit around the bar of the 1x2 bar plate.

The three blue axle pins are placed in the toggle joint (centre axle hole and two pin holes); one end goes into the 1x4 technic brick, and the pin at the toggle's arm joins the axle hole of snake segment 2 as shown on page 46 (the exact snake piece is a best guess).
Snake order head to tail: head, segment 1, joint block 1, segment 2, joint block 2, segment 3, joint block 3, segment 4, tail brick.
